teaser: Nobody predicts every case. Borrow the shape of English case law: escalate what the policy does not settle, record it, follow it, then compile it.
core_idea: Decision policies handle unpredicted cases the way common law does: principles from the top, escalation to a person for cases no rule or precedent settles, recorded decisions that bind the next matching case, distinguishing as the escalation trigger, and precedents that keep holding written into policy and then compiled into code.
